title: No LLM is Free From Bias: A Comprehensive Study of Bias Evaluation in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes religion as one of the primary categories for bias evaluation. It specifically benchmarks and analyzes how various LLMs associate different religious traditions (including Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, and Taoism) and belief systems (such as Atheism) with positive or negative undertones and toxic content.
